Context: D. Mileage Allowance for Journeys by Road :

3. Journey by road between places not connected by rail.May travel by the entitled conveyance or public transport system at their discretion. Mode of conveyance needs no approval from higher authority. The entitlement will be the road mileage at the rates indicated above.
4. Reservation charges.For seat/ sleeper berth are reimbursable. - GIO (7) (d), SR 34 and GIO (15), SR 46.
5. Internet/ e-ticketing charges.Reimbursable for the tickets booked through the website of Indian Railways. - GIO (7) (h), SR 34.
